title: Fix HP hardware volume buttons not working
summary: If the physical volume up/down buttons on your HP laptop do not work, adding a specific kernel module parameter for intel_hid usually fixes it.

steps.explain: Add the kernel module parameter enable_5_button_array=1 for intel_hid. Create or edit /etc/modprobe.d/intel_hid.conf and add: options intel_hid enable_5_button_array=1
Reboot the system to apply the module parameter.

rollback.explain: Remove the options line from /etc/modprobe.d/intel_hid.conf and reboot.
